name: Chris Emiri Meryl
original_name: クリス・恵美梨・メリル
source:
Chris is a devout sister and a dormitory supervisor who is strict to both herself and others. She  rarely reveals her emotions. However, Chris also has the ability of listening sincerely to the worries of the students in her school, so she is adored by them.

[Translated from Getchu and [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%83%92%E3%83%A1%E3%82%B4%E3%83%88%E3%83%BB%E3%83%9E%E3%82%B9%E3%82%AB%E3%83%AC%E3%82%A4%E3%83%89_%E3%80%9C%E3%81%8A%E5%AC%A2%E6%A7%98%E3%81%9F%E3%81%A1%E3%81%AE%E6%88%AF%E3%82%8C%E3%80%9C]Wikipedia[/url].]

Chris is a devout sister and a dormitory supervisor who is strict to both herself and others. She  rarely reveals her emotions. However, Chris also has the ability of listening sincerely to the worries of the students in her school, so she is adored by them.
